ana: quick thread  planning a late-night kernel rollout v2.15.0 + quant qf-2026-04 at 01:30 UTC. small change: kernel scheduler tweak + tighter kv flushing. rollout plan: 0.5% -> 4% -> 25% -> 100%. 5m holds, auto-pin if 5xx >0.35% for 5m. need ops watch on OOM and kv-evictions.

deploybot: scheduled job=deploy-5200000000 preflight=01:00 UTC. will run prebake, smoke and perf microbench. /status to follow.

michael: FYI matmul ABI unchanged. main risk is kv flush timing causing transient miss spike. please run kv-scan on canary nodes.

ops: oncall ready. will monitor evictions, OOM, and GPU temp. have rollback template ready.

eng-sre-bot: preflight PASSED 01:02 UTC. checksum ok.

deploybot: canary 0.5% started 01:30:10 UTC. link: https://internal.redwood/metrics/deploy-5200000000

michael: early signals: p99 +2.2%, kv-miss +0.04% absolute. nothing alarming yet.

ana: (typo) ana: noted. hold for 5m then promote to 4% if stable. ops please flag immediately if kv-miss >0.5% absolute.

deploybot: 01:36 UTC promoted to 4%. will wait 5m.

ops: watching. no evictions so far.

deploybot: 01:50 UTC promoted to 25%. final promote scheduled after 10m pause.

ana: publishing short RN draft after 100%: "scheduler perf + kv flush reliability fix".

deploybot: rollout to 100% complete 02:05:25 UTC. no auto-pins triggered. metrics summary: https://internal.redwood/metrics/deploy-5200000000/summary. :white_check_mark:
